blocks.text: A lounge with an outdoor terrace, fitness room, sauna and steam room, media lounge, shared barbecue, car wash station, bike room and parking with charging outlets.
Fantom is on Thrift Avenue on the west side of White Rock, a few blocks from the Town Centre. With 25 homes, listings are rare and strata costs are shared by fewer owners.

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Fantom owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
